name: Santa’s List (Minor Artifact)
body:
Slot none; CL 20th; Weight —; Aura faint divination

DESCRIPTION

This sealed scroll is divided in three columns, titled “Nice,” “Naughty,” and “Neither,” in an ornate gilded handwriting.

Under each column there is space for a hundred names. If the owner speaks aloud the true name of a living creature, that name appears on the list under one of the columns, depending on the creature’s alignment with respect to good and evil. If a dead creature’s name or a false name is spoken, nothing appears on the list. Every time the scroll is rolled and unrolled again, all the names written on it disappear.

DESTRUCTION

Santa’s list is destroyed if 100 names of evil creature’s are written by hand in the “Nice” column, and 100 names of good creatures in the “Naughty” column.
